newsitem.title: UK: Asarco to sell Grupo Mexico when conditions right.
newsitem.headline: Asarco to sell Grupo Mexico when conditions right.

text.p: North American metal miner and producer ASARCO Inc will sell off its holding in Grupo Mexico when conditions are right, Asarco Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer Richard de J. Osborne said.
Asarco has a 23.6 percent investment in Grupo Mexico, which has 13 mines and nine metallurgical plants.
"We will sell it (our holding) when market conditions are right," Osborne said at a presentation to analysts.
It is unlikely that the disposal will be to a single buyer, or that the holding, which is valued at $400 million, will go in one tranche.
"The cash will be used to pay back debt, or possibly an Asarco share buy-back," he added.

Following the company's sale last year of its holdings in M.I.M. Holdings Ltd, which netted $326 million, Asarco's debt to capital ratio is down to 26.7 percent, close to its 25 percent target, he added.
